categories.name: Core Map Engine
categories.description: The base mapping library that renders the map (e.g., Leaflet, MapLibre GL JS).

categories.name: Framework Wrapper
categories.description: Wrappers for core engines to use in specific frameworks like React, Vue, Svelte (e.g., react-leaflet).

categories.name: Geocoder / Search
categories.description: UI control for searching and navigating to locations or addresses.

categories.name: Drawing Tools
categories.description: UI controls for drawing polygons, lines, and markers on the map.

categories.name: Clustering
categories.description: Plugins for grouping multiple markers into clusters at higher zoom levels.

categories.name: Routing & Directions
categories.description: UI controls for calculating and displaying routes between points.

categories.name: Layer Control
categories.description: UI components to toggle different base maps and overlays.

categories.name: Marker & Popup
categories.description: Custom markers, tooltips, and informational popups.

categories.name: Data Visualization
categories.description: Advanced rendering of large geospatial datasets (e.g., deck.gl heatmaps).

categories.name: Legend
categories.description: UI component displaying the meaning of symbols and colors on the map.

categories.name: Mini Map
categories.description: A small overview map to provide context for the main map view.
